title: Protocols of the Elders of Zion as a Russian secret police hoax

tellings.quote: We know it was a hoax invented by the secret police in Russia during the time of thesar even before the Soviet Union.

plain: The Protocols of the Elders of Zion, a document claiming to reveal a secret Jewish plan to rule the world, was a fake made up by the Russian secret police under the Tsar, before the Soviet Union existed. That is how Peter Levenda, an author who writes about occult history and secret societies, describes it to Michels in 2025, saying "we know it was a hoax." He tells it as an example of how a secret agency can invent a story that shapes what millions believe.
